


----------------------------------keycloak-------------------------------------

docker run -d --name keycloak -p 8085:8080 -e KEYCLOAK_ADMIN=admin -e KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:25.0.0 start-dev

curl -X POST "http://localhost:8085/realms/microservices-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "grant_type=password" \
  -d "client_id=api-gateway" \
  -d "client_secret=api-gateway-secret-please-change" \
  -d "username=testuser" \
  -d "password=test123"
